title: Seabrook Harbor & Marine
specs: Largest and best-equipped boatyard facility on the Gulf Coast
Largest dry-stack facility in Louisiana with indoor storm-protected storage for 200 boats
All boats stored must have proof of insurance (minimum liability), battery disconnect switch, 4 dock lines, and 2 fenders
Persons born after January 1, 1984 must complete a boating education course and carry proof to operate motorboat over 10 hp

options.name: Wet Slip Docking
options.detail: Wet slip docking with 30 and 50 Amp power for deep draft vessels

options.detail: Pontoon boat rental on Lake Pontchartrain with capacity for 16 people and equipped with safety and recreational gear

options.name: Dry-Stack Boat Storage
options.detail: Indoor dry-stack storage facility for boats 20 to 40 feet long with unlimited in and out water moves

options.name: Marine Repair Services
options.detail: Full service boat repair including painting, carpentry, mechanical, electrical, and fiberglass fabrication

blurb: SeaBrook Harbor & Marine offers dry-stack boat storage protecting vessels from water and weather, boat rentals on Lake Pontchartrain, and a full-service marine repair facility. Guests can rent pontoon boats equipped with safety and recreational gear. The facility includes wet slip docking, fueling, a ship store, and a large repair yard with specialized services including painting, carpentry, and mechanical repairs.
extraNote: $3.00 per foot charge for loading or offloading from a trailer · Hurricane policy: 24-hour window to remove vessel; building designed to withstand 130 mph winds · Storage contracts require current insurance, proof of ownership, photo ID, and credit card on file
